MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: UPPS-P Impulsive Behavior Scale. A 45-item self-report questionnaire measuring trait impulsivity across four subscales. Items are rated on a 1-4 Likert scale.

upps_perseverance.Description: Lack of Perseverance subscale score. Higher scores indicate greater difficulty remaining focused on tasks that may be boring or difficult.

upps_urgency.Description: Urgency subscale score. Higher scores indicate a stronger tendency to act rashly under conditions of strong negative affect.

upps_premeditation.Description: Lack of Premeditation subscale score. Higher scores indicate a greater tendency to act without thinking or deliberating.

upps_sensation_seeking.Description: Sensation Seeking subscale score. Higher scores indicate a greater tendency to enjoy and pursue activities that are exciting and novel.
